name: 文件
subtitle: 聊天文件与电脑文件：Markdown、JSON 预览与编辑

tidy-folder.title: Tidy up the chat folder
tidy-folder.prompt: Please tidy up this chat's folder: list every file with workspace__list, propose a new subfolder structure by topic (at most 6 subfolders), and point out duplicate, outdated or unclearly named files with one reason each. Send me the plan first; move or rename only after I agree, and do not delete any file.

author: 咕咕

prompts.name: tidy-folder
prompts.title: 群文件整理
prompts.prompt: 请整理本群文件夹：先用 workspace__list 列出全部文件，按主题提出新的子文件夹结构（不超过 6 个），指出重复、过期、命名不清的文件，各给一句理由。先把方案发给我确认，我同意后再移动或改名，不要删除任何文件。

contributes.instructions: Chat files: workspace__list(chat_id), create(chat_id,title,content), read/delete(item_id), edit(item_id,old,new). Edits merge live.
